# unifi_switch_stack (Data Source)

Fetches a single switch stack by id via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch a single switch stack by its UUID (Official API).
data "unifi_switch_stack" "core" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the switch stack to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The full switch stack record, including nested lags, serialized as a JSON string.
- `member_device_ids` (List of String) The UUIDs of the devices that are members of the stack.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the switch stack entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `name` (String) The switch stack name.
